newsitem.title: JAPAN: Full text of Toyota statement on U.K. investment.
newsitem.headline: Full text of Toyota statement on U.K. investment.

text.p: The following is the full text of a statement released on Thursday by Toyota Motor Corp (TMC) president Hiroshi Okuda after his remarks on Wednesday about his company's investment in Britain.

The Toyota Motor Corporation (TMC) position regarding future investment in Europe is now under study and nothing has been decided. In the same manner, future investment in the U.K. is being considered as one of many possible options. This policy remains the same and has not changed at all.

For the Burnaston Plant in Derbyshire, England, TMC has invested 880 million to carry out Carina E production capacity of 100,000 units annually. Another 200 million additional investment is currently proceeding for the second factory expansion to newly produce 100,000 Corolla-type passenger vehicles from autumn 1998. This investment is also no change in plan. In every aspect and opportunity, TMC and all related personnel are actively working to speed up these projects.

The procedures and way all TMC new investment decisions will be determined is by considering overall basic business factors such as locations and infrastructure, good labour force, logistics, etc. The EMU is also one aspect of these factors.
Generally, regarding companies which operate in Europe, a unified currency would reduce currency exchange rate fluctuations and risk and would be a significant advantage.
